name: HERMES_DIRECTIVE_DISCOVERY_EMPTY_REASON_20261107
comment: 30 min and exited ok with 'summary.staged = 0'; lib/run_quality could only say 'the receipt does
not say why', because the receipt carried trend_directives/staged/skipped_stale and nothing else.
The producer now counts why it staged nothing (hermes_disabled, skipped_stale, matched,
already_pending, over_cap) and states empty_reason when staged = 0: the reviewed idle token
no_new_input only when every match was already staged/surfaced (so a correct idle zero can grade
GOOD), and a sentence — which stays EMPTY — when the cause is configuration (no directive, hermes
disabled, all stale) or no match at all. Two traps this gate pins: a zero must never go silent,
and no new summary key may shadow the count (run_quality reads COUNT_KEYS in order, where
'candidates' and 'total' outrank 'staged'). Hermetic: fake cursor, stubbed discovery, no DB.
Live read-only 2026-11-07: 375 directives, 7 hermes-disabled, 4379 matches, 4377 already pending,
2 staged — the lane is saturated by an undrained staging table, not by a defect in this script.
